_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Cabo Verde covering uninhabited discovery, Portuguese colonisation, slave trade hub, PAIGC independence, and diaspora.

ethnic_groups.name: Mestiço/Crioulo (Mixed)
ethnic_groups.notes: Mixed African-Portuguese descent; dominant population; Kriolu Creole culture; no indigenous tribes as islands were uninhabited before Portuguese colonisation

ethnic_groups.name: African descent
ethnic_groups.notes: Descendants of enslaved Africans brought from West African coast (Wolof, Mandinka, Temne, Balanta origins)

country_profile.notes: No indigenous tribes — Cabo Verde was uninhabited before Portuguese discovery in 1456; population is entirely of settler and enslaved origins

natural_resources.notes: Resource-poor volcanic archipelago; fisheries significant; salt historically important (Sal/Boavista); wind/solar potential enormous (consistent trade winds); no minerals of note; relies on imports for nearly everything

military.notes: Tiny military; coast guard primary function (drug transshipment interdiction—Cape Verde on cocaine route Latin America→Europe); US/Portugal military cooperation; Drug Enforcement Agency (US) maritime cooperation

debt_aid.notes: High debt from infrastructure investment; graduated from LDC in 2007 (success story); tourism-dependent economy vulnerable to shocks; MCC (US Millennium Challenge) compacts

education.notes: Highest literacy rate in West Africa; Portuguese-language instruction; Creole (Kriolu) dominant spoken language; strong education investment; many students study abroad in Portugal/Brazil

diaspora_migration.notes: More Cape Verdeans abroad than at home (unique globally); largest communities in USA (New England, especially Massachusetts ~265k), Portugal (~80k), France, Netherlands; remittances critical lifeline; transnational identity

digital_economy.notes: Submarine cables (WACS/EllaLink) provide good connectivity; digital government advancing; tourism-tech growing; plans for tech hub/digital nomad visas; small but educated workforce

former_leaders.name: Aristides Pereira
former_leaders.notes: First president; PAIGC/PAICV leader; Cabral's deputy

former_leaders.name: António Mascarenhas Monteiro
former_leaders.notes: First freely elected president after multiparty transition

former_leaders.name: Pedro Pires
former_leaders.notes: Won 2001 by 17 votes; Mo Ibrahim Prize 2011

former_leaders.name: Jorge Carlos Fonseca
former_leaders.notes: MpD; two terms; strengthened democratic institutions

910.name: Geological and Pre-Human History
910.description: Volcanic archipelago formation; no indigenous human population; uninhabited until European arrival.

sub_clusters.name: Volcanic Formation of the Archipelago
sub_clusters.description: Hotspot volcanism creates ten islands and several islets off the West African coast.

sub_clusters.name: Uninhabited Archipelago
sub_clusters.description: No evidence of pre-European settlement; possible visits by Arab and African sailors.

920.name: Portuguese Discovery and Early Settlement
920.description: Genoese-Portuguese discovery; settlement of Santiago; founding of Ribeira Grande.

sub_clusters.name: Discovery by Cadamosto and da Noli
sub_clusters.description: António de Noli and Alvise Cadamosto discover the uninhabited islands for Portugal.

sub_clusters.name: Founding of Ribeira Grande
sub_clusters.description: First European city in the tropics; Cidade Velha; receives city charter 1533.

930.name: Atlantic Slave Trade Hub
930.description: Cabo Verde as crucial waystation and slave depot in the transatlantic slave trade; Creole society formation.

sub_clusters.name: Santiago Slave Depot
sub_clusters.description: Enslaved Africans from Guinea coast processed through Santiago before shipment to Americas.

sub_clusters.name: Criolo Society Formation
sub_clusters.description: Mestiço Creole population; Kriolu language development; unique Afro-Portuguese culture.

sub_clusters.name: Piracy and Economic Decline
sub_clusters.description: Drake sacks Ribeira Grande 1585; pirate raids; economic decline as trade routes shift.

940.name: Late Colonial Cabo Verde
940.description: Abolition of slavery; recurring famines; Mindelo coaling station; colonial neglect.

sub_clusters.name: Abolition of Slavery in Cabo Verde
sub_clusters.description: Gradual emancipation; contract labour replaces slavery; plantation system declines.

sub_clusters.name: Recurring Famines
sub_clusters.description: Devastating droughts and famines kill tens of thousands; 1941–1943 famine kills ~30,000; Portuguese neglect.

sub_clusters.name: Mindelo Coaling Station
sub_clusters.description: São Vicente becomes major coal resupply port for transatlantic steamships; British investment.

sub_clusters.name: Claridade Literary Movement
sub_clusters.description: Cultural and literary movement asserting Cabo Verdean Creole identity; forerunner of nationalism.

950.name: PAIGC Liberation and Independence
950.description: Amílcar Cabral's PAIGC; Guinea-Bissau-Cabo Verde joint liberation; independence 1975; 1980 split.

sub_clusters.name: PAIGC Founded (Cabo Verde Wing)
sub_clusters.description: Amílcar Cabral founds PAIGC for dual liberation of Guinea-Bissau and Cabo Verde.

sub_clusters.name: Independence of Cabo Verde
sub_clusters.description: Independence 5 July 1975 after Portuguese Carnation Revolution; Aristides Pereira president.

sub_clusters.name: PAICV Single-Party State
sub_clusters.description: One-party socialist state; Guinea-Bissau unity plan abandoned after 1980 coup; PAIGC becomes PAICV.

960.name: Democratic Cabo Verde
960.description: Multiparty democracy; PAICV-MpD alternation; economic liberalisation; diaspora connections.

sub_clusters.name: Multiparty Transition
sub_clusters.description: Constitutional reform; MpD wins 1991 elections; peaceful democratic transition.

sub_clusters.name: Economic Development Model
sub_clusters.description: Tourism-led growth; ECOWAS integration; graduation from LDC status 2007; mid-income aspirations.

sub_clusters.name: Cabo Verdean Diaspora
sub_clusters.description: More Cabo Verdeans abroad than on the islands; communities in US, Portugal, Senegal; remittance economy.

unassigned_events.note: Events not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
